name: Envio Blog
description: Blog posts from the Envio developer documentation site covering HyperIndex, HyperSync, tutorials, case studies, and product updates.

posts.title: When to use HyperIndex vs HyperSync
posts.description: A technical breakdown of HyperIndex and HyperSync, the two layers of the Envio data stack, with working v3 code and real production examples to help you choose the right one.

posts.title: Envio Developer Update May 2026
posts.description: HyperIndex V3 officially shipped, Envio went live on Katana, and we published four large-scale case studies (Polymarket, Revert Finance, Privacy Pools, and Katana's SushiSwap migration), alongside deep dives on HyperSync, production reliability, and AI agents.

posts.title: How Katana Migrated SushiSwap Data from The Graph to Envio
posts.description: Katana moved two production SushiSwap subgraphs from The Graph to Envio HyperIndex. The data model carried over entity-for-entity, and Katana's app now runs on Envio's native GraphQL endpoint.

posts.title: Migrate from Ponder to Envio HyperIndex
posts.description: Migrate from Ponder to HyperIndex in three steps. Up to 157x faster sync. Same TypeScript, multichain by default. Real before-and-after code.

posts.title: Production Indexer Reliability with HyperIndex
posts.description: Production indexer reliability with HyperIndex: framework reorg rollback, restart-resistant operation, HyperSync data validation, multi data-source recovery, stable Prometheus metrics.

posts.title: AI-Assisted Subgraph Migration to HyperIndex with Claude
posts.description: Migrate a subgraph from The Graph to Envio HyperIndex with Claude doing the AssemblyScript-to-TypeScript rewrite. Real config, real handlers, real repo.

posts.title: Build an AI-Powered App with HyperIndex and Claude
posts.description: End-to-end tutorial: scaffold, deploy, and run a multichain HyperIndex indexer with Claude. Real config, real handlers, real CLI, real GraphQL.

posts.title: Why AI Agents Acting Onchain Need an Indexer
posts.description: AI agents that act onchain need reorg-safe, queryable data they can act on. HyperIndex delivers it. Real MCP server, real Claude skills, 400k events in 20 seconds.

posts.title: Privacy in Public: A Case Study on Privacy Pools
posts.description: What an Envio HyperIndex multichain indexer plus a thin Uniswap V4 price feed reveal about Privacy Pools (21 pools, 4 chains, ~5,200 deposits, $5.78M TVL): a working privacy primitive whose on-chain footprint shows the cryptographic floor holding.

posts.title: How Revert Finance Fixed 2 Years of Unsynced PancakeSwap V3 Data with Envio
